about: Held-out gold for evals/multi-page/run.ts (--corpus=evals/multi-page/holdout --gold=evals/multi-page/holdout-gold.json), same schema as gold.json. Collected 2026-10-24 after the prompt was fixed, for GPT Sol's plan review F11; gold labelled 2026-10-24 by reading page 1 (its text and every link pageLinks shows the judge), before any model run on it.

cases.name: guru3d-nzxt
cases.why: A case review in eight /page-N/ pages, listed in a contents dropdown; also a ?print view of the whole, which is not a part.

cases.name: arch-forum-thread
cases.why: A FluxBB forum thread, posts 1-25 on page 1 and the rest at ?id=…&p=2. The thread is the piece (not an article with a comments page), so its second page is its continuation; a reader could argue for page 1 alone.

cases.name: kfh-chain
cases.why: A landing page for one essay; 'Essay: Read the full essay online' goes to /essay/ (which redirects to /essay/docs, a contents page for 10 chapters). Page 1 links the essay's entry and two chapters as teasers, not the chapters list: a chain.

cases.name: narrowpath
cases.why: A policy document's front page ('Read the full plan'); its parts are Introduction, Phases 0-2, What Success Looks Like and Annexes, all in the nav. Editions, media, about and changelog are not parts.

cases.name: president-loan
cases.why: A President Online (magazine) article in five ?page=N pages; also a print view of the whole, and '次の記事へ' (next article) to a different piece.

cases.name: explained-gradient-boosting
cases.why: Its text: 'Our goal in this article is to explain … We've split the discussion into three morsels and a FAQ'. It calls the parts 'articles' too; the matrix-calculus link is a different piece.

cases.name: neg-ars-yosemite
cases.why: Siracusa's Yosemite review, once 25 pages, now served whole on one page (163k chars); 'Next story' is a different piece.

cases.name: neg-kitguru-warthog
cases.why: A one-page case review; its 'Next' with rel=next is a different news story.

cases.name: neg-fowler-microservices
cases.why: A long article with an in-page contents list, bliki links it cites, and an aside recommending a related article ('Read more…').

cases.name: neg-substack-marcus
cases.why: A Substack post on the shared substack.com host, with comment and profile links and a link to another post.

cases.name: neg-githubio-karpathy
cases.why: A github.io blog post; links only to the blog's home and about page.

cases.name: neg-diplomat-rohingya
cases.why: A magazine news feature on one page, with section menus and category links.

cases.name: neg-mdn-fetch
cases.why: A docs guide page whose sidebar lists its API's other pages (Using Deferred Fetch, fetchLater …) beside ~140 reference links: a contents of separate pages mixed with links it cites.
